meta.title: Live captions
meta.description: Captures system audio and the microphone, transcribes speech with a local SenseVoice model, translates each line into the language you choose and floats the subtitles over the window. Subtitle translation can run on the cloud default model or on a local OpenAI-compatible model (Ollama/LM Studio); meeting minutes always use the cloud model. Open it from the "Live captions" pill at the bottom right; the first run downloads about 240 MB of recognition models. Audio never leaves the machine — only subtitle text that needs cloud translation or minutes is sent to the model provider.
